Eddy current testing near Charlotte: how mobilization works and what to send for a quote

If you searched for eddy current testing near me from the Charlotte area: Atlantis has no local office, so ET technicians and equipment are sent from Houston to your site, which is the normal model for planned outage and plant work. Each scope is quoted once the tube or part details, access dates and governing code are known, and procedures are reviewed by an ASNT NDT Level III.

What to send for a quote. A tube inspection quote is only as good as the information behind it. The list below lets an ET company scope the work accurately and bring the right probes and reference standards the first time:

  • Number of bundles and tubes, tube material, outside diameter and wall thickness, and whether tubes are straight or U-bend
  • Tube sheet layout drawings and any previous inspection reports or tube maps
  • Who cleans the tubes, and to what standard, before testing starts
  • The outage window, shift pattern and site access and training requirements
  • Who sets the plugging criteria and who signs the final disposition

For surface ET on parts or welds rather than tubing, send the material, coating type and thickness, and the crack orientation of concern, because those decide the probe and frequency.

Comparing eddy current testing services. Companies offering eddy current testing services differ less in equipment than in what they do with the data. Ask which techniques they can field (bobbin, array, rotating probe, remote field, near-field, and IRIS for ultrasonic prove-up), who analyzes the signals and at what certification level, whether you receive the raw data and a tube map, and how reference standards are made and traced. If the same crew will also do surface ET on coated welds, ask for that procedure separately; tube and surface ET are different techniques with different qualifications.

Timing in the Carolinas. Utilities and large plants usually plan major outages for spring and fall, when demand is lower, so tube inspection capacity books up well before those windows. Getting the scope fixed early also leaves time to prepare reference tubes that match unusual materials.

State rules on site. North Carolina operates its own OSHA-approved State Plan for most private-sector employers, so a contractor's safety documentation is checked against state requirements before work starts. Build that review, and the site orientation that follows it, into the schedule rather than discovering it on the first morning.

Background on ET and what it can miss is on the eddy current testing page; for carbon steel bundles see IRIS tube inspection, and for whole outage packages turnaround and shutdown inspection. Charlotte technicians can study the method through ET training, rehearse signal analysis on the Practical NDT eddy current simulator, and find local options on the Charlotte NDT training page. Send your scope through the Charlotte ET request.
